1.text: I'm trying to film a property tour.

2.text: But every few minutes, I stop to type the same follow-up to another seller.

3.text: So I set it up once, in Repeat.

4.text: I write a template and choose which seller statuses it's for.

5.text: Then I turn on Status follow-ups, so each seller gets their message when they're due.

6.text: It stops as soon as a seller replies, and I answer them myself.

7.text: Everything goes out from my own connected WhatsApp.

8.text: Now I can finish the tour without stopping.

9.text: Repeat AI. Set up your follow-ups once, and get back to work.
